text:
Lieber Freund!
Die Sache mit H Weigel ist so gut als abgemacht - Er schickte mir gestern Abend die Zusage - um
lies mich heute hier herein bitten, oder im Fall ich es erlaubte, so wolte er den Donnerstag über bey
mir im Schweineren sein - Ich habe das leztere angenommen und ihm morgen auf eine Seyen
zu mir heraus gebeten. Mir fehlts nun an manche dem alten Herrn so recht zu bewirthen
und das Herrn zu erwärmen. Es ist zum einzigen Wohl unsers Biedern Fürsten, daher sezze ich Sie
Herzer Freund in Requisition - und Bitte um eine Lüttellie alten Mihn Wein und um einen
Buttellie rechten guten alten Süßen Ungarischen Ausbruch, so wie um 6 Stück Pfirsichen und
2 Wein Trauben — Alles andere habe ich
ich bin darum expresse herein gekommen – Solten Sie heute mein Billet nicht treffen, so schicken Sie
mir ja den Wein und die Früchte heraus. Immerdar bleibe ich
Breslau
den 29ten Aug.
1810.
Ihr wahrer Freund und Diener
v Triebenfeld

translation.en: Dear Friend! The business with H[err] Weigel is as good as settled — he sent me his assent yesterday evening — and asked me to come in here today, or, if I would permit it, he would spend Thursday with me at the [uncertain: Schweineren] — I have accepted the latter and have asked him to come out to me tomorrow for a [uncertain: Seyen]. What I now lack is the means to entertain the old gentleman properly and to warm the [uncertain: gentleman/heart]. It is for the sole good of our upright Prince, and therefore I put you, dearest friend, under requisition — and beg for one bottle of old [uncertain: Rhine] wine and for one bottle of really good old sweet Hungarian Ausbruch, likewise for 6 peaches and 2 bunches of grapes — everything else I have; I came in expressly on that account. — Should my note not reach you today, then do by all means send me the wine and the fruit out to me. Ever I remain, Breslau, the 29th of August 1810. Your true friend and servant v Triebenfeld

text_english: Dear Friend! The business with H[err] Weigel is as good as settled — he sent me his assent yesterday evening — and asked me to come in here today, or, if I would permit it, he would spend Thursday with me at the [uncertain: Schweineren] — I have accepted the latter and have asked him to come out to me tomorrow for a [uncertain: Seyen]. What I now lack is the means to entertain the old gentleman properly and to warm the [uncertain: gentleman/heart]. It is for the sole good of our upright Prince, and therefore I put you, dearest friend, under requisition — and beg for one bottle of old [uncertain: Rhine] wine and for one bottle of really good old sweet Hungarian Ausbruch, likewise for 6 peaches and 2 bunches of grapes — everything else I have; I came in expressly on that account. — Should my note not reach you today, then do by all means send me the wine and the fruit out to me. Ever I remain, Breslau, the 29th of August 1810. Your true friend and servant v Triebenfeld
summary_en: Reports that the business with Herr Weigel is as good as settled, his assent having arrived the previous evening, and that Weigel will spend Thursday with the writer in the country. Lacking the means to entertain the old gentleman properly — a matter, he insists, solely for the Prince's good — Triebenfeld requisitions from his correspondent a bottle of old Rhine wine, a bottle of good old sweet Hungarian Ausbruch, six peaches and two bunches of grapes, to be sent out to him if the note arrives late.
summary_de: Meldet, das Geschäft mit Herrn Weigel sei so gut wie abgeschlossen; dieser habe am Vorabend seine Zustimmung übersandt und wolle den Donnerstag bei Triebenfeld verbringen, der ihn stattdessen für den folgenden Tag zu sich hinausgebeten hat. Zur angemessenen Bewirtung des alten Herrn – allein zum Besten des Fürsten – erbittet Triebenfeld vom Adressaten je eine Flasche alten Rheinwein und guten alten süßen ungarischen Ausbruch sowie 6 Pfirsiche und 2 Trauben, nötigenfalls hinauszusenden.
